description: VAT / tax-id format and check digit (AT, BE, DE, DK, FI) — Checks the structure and check digit of up to 100 EU VAT numbers per call (Austria, Belgium, Germany, Denmark, Finland), for an agent about to put a supplier or customer VAT number on an invoice or into a record.
